items.headline: $ZC Crashes 84% as Zipcoin Shuts Down, Plans Token Sale
items.summary: Zipcoin is winding down and selling its token, with team wallets holding just 2.2% of supply. $ZC has plunged 84% in 24 hours on the news.

items.headline: $PUMP Adds Take-Profit & Stop-Loss Orders on EVM Chains
items.summary: Pump.fun is rolling out take-profit and stop-loss tools to Robinhood, BSC, Base, HyperEVM, Arc and Ink. The features have been live on Solana since September.

items.headline: $AZTEC V6 Upgrade Approved, Speeds Up Ethereum Messaging
items.summary: Aztec announced V6 approval, accelerating Ethereum-to-Aztec messaging and funding 30 days of V5 operations during migration. Execution is listed for October 26.

items.headline: $MORPHO Opens Robinhood Stock Tokens for Stablecoin Loans
items.summary: Morpho now lets users borrow $USDG against Robinhood stock tokens like NVDA, SPCX and SPY, with LTV thresholds up to 77%. A fresh DeFi use case for tokenized equities.

items.headline: $DUNE Launches Real-Time Onchain Trading Data Feeds
items.summary: Dune's new market feeds cover trade data from 200+ onchain venues across 12 networks as tokenized markets expand. A big infra play for onchain trading.
